MessagingUser.title: MessagingUser
MessagingUser.description: Authenticated Firebase messaging directory profile linked to the user's Pulse creator identity.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the New Chat picker and inbox.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile sync (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DmThread.title: DmThread
DmThread.description: Real-time 1-on-1 direct message thread summary with deterministic sorted participant IDs and per-member unread counts.

memberUids.description: Sorted two-element array of participant Firebase UIDs.

lastMessageText.description: Preview text of the latest message in the thread.

lastSenderUid.description: Firebase UID of the user who sent the latest message.

unreadCountA.description: Unread message count for participant A.

unreadCountB.description: Unread message count for participant B.

lastMessageAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest message (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the thread was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last thread update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DmMessage.title: DmMessage
DmMessage.description: Individual real-time message inside a 1-on-1 conversation with read receipts and heart likes.

memberUids.description: Denormalized two-element array of participant Firebase UIDs for zero-lookup rules.

likedByUids.description: List of participant UIDs who liked this message.

readByUids.description: List of participant UIDs who have seen this message.

sharedPostId.description: Optional Supabase post or Loop ID shared inside the message.

sharedPostCaption.description: Optional caption snippet of a shared post.

sharedPostImageUri.description: Optional preview URL of a shared post.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the message was sent (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PostComment.title: PostComment
PostComment.description: Comment or threaded reply on a Pulse post or Loop stored in Firestore with like tracking.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the comment author.

authorUsername.description: Pulse handle of the comment author.

authorDisplayName.description: Display name of the comment author.

authorAvatarUrl.description: Optional avatar URL of the comment author.

parentCommentId.description: Optional parent comment ID for threaded replies.

replyToUsername.description: Optional target username being replied to.

likedByUids.description: Bounded list of Firebase UIDs that liked this comment.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the comment was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest comment edit or like update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/messaging_users/{userId}.description: Directory of authenticated Firebase messaging users for New Chat discovery.

/dm_threads/{threadId}.description: 1-on-1 direct message conversation summaries scoped to memberUids.

/dm_threads/{threadId}/messages/{message.description: Real-time direct messages inside a conversation thread with denormalized memberUids.

/posts/{postId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Comments and threaded replies scoped to a specific Pulse post or Loop.
